title: What is the Technology Adoption Barriers Survey (TABS)?
content: What is the Technology Adoption Barriers Survey (TABS)? TABS is a research initiative that collects insights from organizational leaders to help identify and overcome obstacles to technology adoption. The survey helps organizations analyze their own challenges and benchmark against industry trends, with findings shared annually to benefit the broader community.

title: Why do technology adoption barriers matter?
content: Why do technology adoption barriers matter? Technology adoption barriers negatively affect organizational competitiveness and performance. Understanding and addressing these barriers helps organizations make better technology decisions, improve implementation success rates, and achieve better return on investment from technology initiatives. Barriers prevent organizations from leveraging innovations that could significantly improve their operations and outcomes.

title: What are the most common technology adoption barriers?
content: What are the most common technology adoption barriers? The most common barriers include: Cost (financial constraints for hardware, software, and training), Lack of Awareness (insufficient understanding of available technologies), Fear of Change (resistance to altering established routines), Complexity (technology perceived as difficult to learn), Compatibility Issues (integration challenges with existing systems), Infrastructure Limitations (inadequate supporting infrastructure), Skill Gaps (inability to keep pace with rapid technological change), and Security Concerns (risks and compliance challenges).

title: How can I participate in TABS research?
content: How can I participate in TABS research? You can get involved with TABS in several ways: participate in the annual survey to share your organization's experiences, contribute financially to support continued research, volunteer your expertise to help with research and analysis, or become a sponsor to enable broader research initiatives. All contributions help advance understanding of technology adoption challenges and solutions. Note: TABS is not a 501(c)(3) organization, so contributions are not tax-deductible as charitable donations.
